dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Hmmm... Looks like the Doge father is no more and tweets can’t bring Dogecoin to the moon anymore! Maybe Elon lost all credibility in the crypto community!?🤔

@elonmusk Love the attempt Elon, but it seems you played too much, too far with the market specially talking about Bitcoin. Now at least people should stop begging you to tweet about Dogecoin like their losses and stupidity are your fault.
